doc.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25

title: Old-timers in the brass band
summary: McNeil and others name veterans such as Buster Moore, Eddie Richardson, Cal Blunt, Louis Cappa and George Sterling.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I don't think they're going to do that. Some of the other guys old times played along with us since I've been playing with you all. Who are? I know Freddie on the tram horn. He's one of the old times. Yeah. He rang the pretty got his horn.
What's his name? Freddie what? I don't know his last name. He's a pretty good tram man man. Yeah he played now. He played with Buster too. You know Buster the tram man. You know Buster Moore?
Yeah he's one. Yeah I'm trying to get him on my outfit now. You know he'll make a box.
Yeah let's see now. I'm trying to think of who else is in that band. Eddie Richardson.
Yeah Eddie Richardson. Eddie Richardson. Yeah he's in that band.

Yeah Cal's been around for quite some time too. Yeah Cal Blunt, Eddie Richardson, and Freddie Kepler. Freddie. Yeah well. Not Freddie David. What's his name? Louis. Louis Kepler. Louis Kepler. He's with us.
He played in the brass band though. And the snare drummer. How old is he?
George. George Sterling. Yeah Sterling. He should be around about close to 60 years old. Around in the 60s or. I know he's over in the 50s. Yeah.
Yeah late 50s. George, if you look at it good George, look older than me man. That's true. Said the same must be in that letter, right? What you kept. That uh.
Yeah we looked at that one. He wanted to see it, I wanted to show it to him.
